title: Pure End of the World
summary: Pure End of the World Ritual build uniting Demise, King of Armageddon, Ruin, Queen of Oblivion, and their Level 10 evolutions with generic Ritual searchers and Rank 10 Xyz finishers. Ruler of the End of the World bypasses needing a Ritual Spell in hand by banishing one straight from the Deck to Ritual Summon itself, then wipes the board and surges to 5900 ATK.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pre-Preparation of Rites adds End of the World alongside either Demise, King of Armageddon or Ruin, Queen of Oblivion from your Deck or GY to your hand.
Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands searches any Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell on Normal Summon, grabbing Ruler of the End of the World or Cycle of the World.
Preparation of Rites searches Level 4 Demise, Agent of Armageddon or Ruin, Angel of Oblivion from the Deck and recovers a Ritual Spell from your GY.

summary.title: Opening: Ruler of the End of the World
steps: Activate Breaking of the World and reveal a Ritual Monster in hand to match its Level with a monster on the field, or Normal Summon Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands to search a missing piece.

Reveal Ruler of the End of the World in your hand and pay 2000 LP to banish End of the World or Cycle of the World directly from your Deck, applying its Ritual Summon effect to Tribute monsters and summon Ruler of the End of the World.
Trigger Breaking of the World on the Ritual Summon of Demise or Ruin (Ruler is treated as Demise, King of Armageddon on the field) to draw 1 card or destroy 1 card on the field.

After wiping the board and attacking with two Level 10 Ritual bosses, overlay them in Main Phase 2 for Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max to burn for 2000 damage and stack Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Juggernaut Liebe.

summary.title: Supreme Ritual Clause & Mini Rituals
summary.text: Demise, Supreme King of Armageddon and Ruin, Supreme Queen of Oblivion gain upgraded effects when Ritual Summoned using only Ritual Monsters as Tribute: Supreme Demise's board wipe costs 0 LP instead of 2000 LP, and Supreme Ruin can make two attacks during each Battle Phase. Because Ruler of the End of the World, Demise, Agent of Armageddon, and Ruin, Angel of Oblivion are all treated as Demise, King of Armageddon or Ruin, Queen of Oblivion, they satisfy name checks and provide GY protection (Agent prevents your Rituals from being destroyed; Angel stops the opponent from responding to your Rituals' attacks).

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Ruler of the End of the World pays 2000 LP on the field to destroy all other cards on the field and gain 2900 ATK (reaching 5900 ATK).
Demise, Supreme King of Armageddon makes your Ritual Monsters immune to battle destruction and nukes all other cards while burning for 200 damage per destroyed opponent's card.
Ruin, Supreme Queen of Oblivion grants your Ritual Monsters effect-destruction immunity and burns the opponent for the original ATK of monsters it destroys by battle.
Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max and Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Juggernaut Liebe close out games using two Level 10 Ritual Monsters.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Cycle of the World Ritual Summons Demise or Ruin from the hand or Deck by Tributing field monsters, and shuffles itself from the GY into the Deck to add End of the World from the Deck and recover a Demise or Ruin from the GY.
Turning of the World is a Quick-Play Spell that Tributes a Ritual Monster from your hand to Ritual Summon Demise or Ruin from your hand or Deck on either turn.
Renewal of the World banishes a Ritual Monster from your Deck on activation, then Tributes that banished monster to Ritual Summon a Demise or Ruin from your hand or GY.

main: Ruler of the End of the World

Level 10 Ritual boss (treated as Demise, King of Armageddon in hand/field) that reveals itself in hand and pays 2000 LP to banish a Ritual Spell from Deck and apply its Ritual Summon effect, then pays 2000 LP on field to destroy all other cards and gain 2900 ATK.
Demise, Supreme King of Armageddon

Level 10 Ritual boss that makes your Ritual Monsters immune to battle destruction and pays 2000 LP (for free if Ritual Summoned using only Ritual Monsters) to destroy all other cards on the field and burn for 200 per destroyed opponent's card.
Ruin, Supreme Queen of Oblivion

Level 10 Ritual boss that makes your Ritual Monsters immune to card effect destruction, attacks twice during each Battle Phase if Ritual Summoned using only Ritual Monsters, and burns for the destroyed monster's original ATK.
Demise, King of Armageddon
Classic Level 8 Ritual boss searchable by Pre-Preparation of Rites that pays 2000 LP to destroy all other cards on the field.
Ruin, Queen of Oblivion
Classic Level 8 Ritual boss searchable by Pre-Preparation of Rites that can attack once again in a row when it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Demise, Agent of Armageddon
Level 4 Ritual Monster treated as Demise, King of Armageddon that destroys 1 face-up monster on Summon and protects Ritual Monsters when sent to the GY.
Ruin, Angel of Oblivion
Level 4 Ritual Monster treated as Ruin, Queen of Oblivion that attacks twice on monsters and prevents opponent activations when sent to the GY.
Cycle of the World
Quick-Play Ritual Spell that tributes monsters from your field to Ritual Summon Demise or Ruin from your hand OR Deck, and recycles itself from the GY to add End of the World and recover Demise/Ruin.
End of the World
Classic Ritual Spell that Ritual Summons Demise or Ruin and enables Pre-Preparation of Rites.
Turning of the World
Quick-Play Spell that tributes a Ritual Monster from your hand to Ritual Summon Demise or Ruin from your hand OR Deck during either player's turn.
Breaking of the World
Field Spell that reveals a Ritual Monster to make its Level match a monster on the field, and either draws 1 card or destroys 1 card on the field whenever Demise or Ruin is Ritual Summoned.
Renewal of the World
Continuous Trap that banishes a Ritual Monster from your Deck on activation and tributes it to Ritual Summon from hand or GY.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Searches End of the World + Demise, King of Armageddon or Ruin, Queen of Oblivion.
Preparation of Rites
Searches Demise, Agent of Armageddon and recovers Cycle of the World or End of the World from the GY.
Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
Searches Ruler of the End of the World or Cycle of the World on Normal Summon.
extra: Rank 10 Xyz made with two Level 10 End of the World Ritual bosses to inflict 2000 burn damage.
Rank 11 Xyz stacked over Gustav Max for 6000 ATK.
